Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated two distinct biblical figures, Keturah and Hagar, based on a misinterpretation of external commentary rather than the primary source text. While the WebSurfer correctly identified Genesis 25:1-4 stating Abraham married "Keturah" after Sarah's death, the Planner introduced an unsupported assumption that "Keturah" is an alternative name for "Hagar" (citing Rashi/Jewish Encyclopedia). This conflation contradicts the explicit text of the Bible verse provided in the search results, which clearly names the wife as Keturah. Consequently, the Planner changed the final answer from the textually supported "Keturah" to the erroneous "Hagar."
